# Representative HVSC DMC tunes for the clusters the generalised recogniser now
# handles.  Format: "<byte_exact> <HVSC relative path>" (paths only; HVSC works
# are copyright, never committed).  byte_exact=1 => a generation the player
# reproduces byte-exact (init-$37 or a modelled init-$1d body; verified against
# the py65 register oracle); byte_exact=0 => a recognised DMC that is NOT
# reproduced byte-exact (an unmodelled generation, or a hand-customized init-$1d
# build that wraps the play entry / relocates the AD/SR helper).  Resolved under
# $HVSC; skips cleanly when unset.
#
# 2-entry (init/play) dispatch, identical $37 body -- sidid $37/$85 cluster:
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bart/Summertime.sid
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bart/Cuba_Libre.sid
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bart/Oldline3.sid
# 2-entry dispatch, identical body, init entry $39 -- sidid $39/$85 cluster:
1 MUSICIANS/D/Doxx/Hendrix_Live.sid
1 MUSICIANS/D/Doxx/Nuclear_Disaster.sid
1 MUSICIANS/D/Doxx/Skyhigh_Tune.sid
# Relocated $37-generation builds (load != $1000): byte-exact after the
# absolute-operand fix (previously mis-played):
1 GAMES/A-F/Brutally_Brainstorm.sid
1 MUSICIANS/R/Robric/Action_Tank_2.sid
# Later generation (init-$1d, markers $7e/$7d/$7f): now reproduced byte-exact
# (the modelled uniform body + note-cell/rest-tail sub-layouts):
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bakker_Nantco/Glorious.sid
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bayliss_Richard/Rocket_n_Roll.sid
# Relocated play entry (dispatch play -> base+$50, not base+$85): the same v1d
# engine with its play entry shifted out of the id-string region (engine
# unchanged at base+$b0, order table located from the init store site).  The
# generalised anchor recognises + plays these byte-exact:
1 DEMOS/G-L/Kordiaukis_Mix.sid
1 DEMOS/G-L/Love_with_U.sid
1 MUSICIANS/L/Logan/Roboczy.sid
# v1d builds whose release helper ($17ec) does NOT clear AD/SR (STA $100f,X; RTS,
# the AD/SR stores sit dead past the RTS) -- byte-exact once the release is read
# from the code rather than assumed to clear (release_clears_adsr):
1 MUSICIANS/L/Lio/Coool.sid
1 MUSICIANS/L/Logan/Trance_to_War.sid
# Scene-modified init-$37 builds: the $133d release is patched to a JSR that also
# zeroes AD/SR (an envelope-clearing hard-restart).  pydmcsid detects the patch
# (v37_release_mode) and reproduces it byte-exact; stock $37 builds are untouched:
1 MUSICIANS/W/Willi/Insider_01.sid
# Hand-customized init-$1d builds: recognised as $1d but NOT byte-exact -- a
# wrapped play entry (relocator/extra-code stub, play != base+3) or a relocated
# AD/SR helper (JSR $1230 not the modelled $184b):
0 MUSICIANS/L/Lyon_Feniks/Digital_Sound_3.sid
0 MUSICIANS/Z/Zyron/Funk-a-Duck.sid
0 MUSICIANS/T/Tragic_Error/Ode_to_Gaston.sid
# $937 CIA-multispeed appended-wrapper sub-family of the $94a line: the PSID
# header init/play resolve into an appended $2xxx divide-by-6 multispeed wrapper
# that runs the resident MAIN play (the modelled $1d body) once every 6 calls and
# a reorganised per-voice REFRESH body (base+$8f0, phase-masked non-row ticks) on
# the other 5.  Recognised as "nn" and reproduced byte-exact by Player937:
1 MUSICIANS/P/Psych858o/Dude_with_Attitude.sid
1 MUSICIANS/P/Psych858o/My_Rusty_Love_C64.sid
1 MUSICIANS/P/Psych858o/Losing_Control.sid
# $94a $85-body sub-variant whose note onset writes CTRL inline (STA) instead of
# the modelled JMP/BIT: recognised as "nn" but NOT reproduced byte-exact:
0 MUSICIANS/H/Heinmueck/Redable_Rain.sid
